# [TASK] Make the config-service tests assert served content

## Task
The suite passes even when the config server serves nothing. Pointing
`SPRING_CLOUD_CONFIG_SERVER_NATIVE_SEARCHLOCATIONS` at an empty directory,
with no source change, still gives 5 of 5 green.

Causes: the only content assertion matches text the server echoes back from
the request path; the rest assert HTTP 200 plus a non-null body, and the
response envelope is never null.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Tests parse `propertySources` and assert real values, not substrings of the envelope
- [x] A test asserts placeholders are served unresolved, e.g. `jwt.secret` comes back as the literal `${JWT_SECRET}`
- [x] A test compares dev against prod on a property whose value genuinely differs
- [x] Pointing the search location at an empty directory makes the suite fail

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3

## Notes
Verified: `ServedConfigurationContentTest.java` asserts served content.
